text: {"lessons":["I should make decisions from current information and my investment plan, not from my average cost or the desire to recover a loss; selling Stock E at a loss and later buying it back higher is a reminder to avoid reactive trades.","I should avoid making large changes based on a single month’s price move. My account has fluctuated, so I need a consistent approach and a long-term view.","Because I want to buy an apartment within ten years, I should balance growth with risk: diversify, keep enough cash for flexibility, and invest only what fits my goals and time horizon."]}
